title: A Costumed Encounter
description: It is the duty of heirs of the sun to bring light wherever they go. In other words, it's my duty as an expert on Halloween to be a guiding light for first timers. "W-wait, hold on a second! Just what the heck's going on here?!" I hear she was once a fellow lancer. Sometimes all it takes to help someone open up is a little kindness. I just have to show her how much fun it is to spend Halloween with others! (Ramses' slightly misplaced kindness)

title: A Dream of Tender Warmth
description: My dear, beloved older brother was so kind to me, so helpful. "Didn't he hate mushrooms? Mrmm... Dias is so weird." I was having a strange dream, but it made me happy, too. I think it was because of this book. Maybe with this, I can get more people to see how truly kind Dias is... (Words mumbled by the dozing Yuffie)

title: A Game for Complete Darkness
description: I stand alone, though I may be a dark presence in front of my flock of "sheep" that I guide. "An attack like that will not bring out the darkness. That is what my inner soul is saying." It might not be such a bad thing to go out into battle and wielding my dagger in darkness. Being something other than just a symbol of darkness could be something. Just a secret to myself. (Corvus' simple yet complex thoughts)

title: A Glorious Blooming of Beauty
description: Wadatsumi has seasonal festivals, and it was at one of these that I first learned about the fine art of appreciating the night sky lit up with fireworks. "Look at that, Kon! It's so bright and beautiful!" A girl from the Kuzunoha village suddenly appeared at my side, and I found my eyes drawn to her, for she was even more enraptured by the fireworks than I was. (Excerpt from the chapter "Cultures of Beauty", as taken from Samuel Northam's "Wadatsumi: Island of Mystery")

title: A Hero's Wish is Forever
description: I will wield this blade as I always have: to protect my king, and so that both of our wishes may someday be granted. Masakado looks to the sky, his wish as steadfast as his blade. His fellow hero Dark Olivier is similarly lost in thoughts of events unknown. Though they gather under the same king, their reasons for doing so, the burdens they bear, and the lands they hail from could not be more different. And though it may be for their own ends, these two heroes cast themselves upon the battlefield together. While the world is ever-changing, this one event will be everlasting.
listingHtml:
A Hero's Wish is Forever
Crystal of Re:union

title: A Hopeful Future
description: We will continue to protect everybody's happiness! Right, Allie? proclaimed a girl who took back the blue skies after overcoming trials and tribulations, the orphaned legacy of the previous master who has blossomed to become a fine master herself. This gentle girl, though charming and frail, can be quite reliable. The path she walks will surely cross with that intense gunslinger's once again.

title: A Love So Tender
description: At times the wind is gentle, barely strong enough to rustle her hairpin; at times it is powerful enough to gouge the earth out from under her feet. Humans are powerless against the changing tides of nature. "Won't you please hear my wish?" She murmurs these words under breath, but leaves the rest unuttered. To protect the people I love and the land on which they live, I will live on as the Vessel of Purification. Even should this duty I charge upon myself be a sin against the laws of nature, so let it be. (Emmel's Resolution)

title: A Mission Well-done
description: Astaroth rumbles with agitation in his briefcase. The mission ran longer than expected, thanks to our slippery target. After several hours, we managed to corner the trembling fool in the dining hall. I let Astaroth have his long-overdue dinner while I had mine. From his satisfied snarls, I'd wager it was delicious. As for me, the steak was cold and overdone, but nothing inedible. (A page from Grimm I's personal mission log)

title: A Momentary Rest
description: We cannot be taken lightly just because we are on the outskirts of the continent. Our young chief, always galvanizing us to do what is best for our country, was found asleep, half buried in books; a rare sight. "Well, it's about time he took a break anyway. Perhaps we should fetch him a blanket." The researchers turned heel toward the rest station. It was rare to see the lab so filled with sympathy. (Excerpt from the Memoirs of Sorcery Research Department Chief Investigator Bill)
listingHtml:
A Momentary Rest
-

title: A Night of Drinking Lifeblood
description: I am the king of this cesspool. Here, I walk a path that is neither righteous nor evil. "That's right, I'm the law down here. If you have any objections, come face me again." I am the law. You say that the more lives I devour, the less human I become? If no one can accept me for what I am, then what difference does it make? I will force them all onto my side! (Dead Nine's Declaration)

title: A Party that Never Ends
description: So, this is the infamous Wadatsumi New Year's festival that Captain Kagura was talking about. I think I rather like this look. The festival isn't half bad, either, thanks to the company. "Captain Monzein, you can't just guzzle it down like that! It's sacred wine!" Everything is perfect in this moment; so perfect that I almost wish I could live in this moment forever, but of course, that's impossible. I'll just have to enjoy it while it lasts, and raise a glass for the good times still to come in the New Year. (Othima's monologue)

title: A Prayer and a Wish
description: I cannot grant Emmel's wishes. That's just how wishes are. But there are moments when I can bring a smile to her, and possibly some comfort. "This is my wish for you, Emmel." I place a lily in the vase, and feel kinship with it. I, too, am but a single flower, capable of nothing more than swinging my axe and throwing myself into the fray of battle, while she is destined to exorcise the corruption, and someday give her life for this land. (Julia's Wish)

title: A Quiet Year for the Princess and Sacred Beast
description: Never has ringing in the New Year felt so pleasant. I guess these things really do depend on your circumstances.

title: A Resolution To Stick Together
description: Guidance for the world should come from the people, which may have its pros and cons. All that is certain is that mercy must be given to the children. "A true savior? That has nothing to do with us." Thoughts like that may be wrong in this land but I look to find something better. I'll never let go of my little step-brother's hand. (Helene's unwavering and gentle feelings)

Then again, once Leafah gets going, there really is no stopping her. I'm sorry, Leafah. I promise I'll give your remains a proper burial. (Caris' impossible choice)

title: A Smile Suspended in Shadow
description: I command dominion over magic. Do you understand what that means? I thought you offered me that frivolous doll in jest, but it appears that you were serious. Then and there I challenged you: "Demonstrate your brilliance before me. Is it worthy of my audience, I wonder?" I now know the answer to that question; it is why I am here. That makes it my turn to demonstrate my brilliance to you. Behold my might, as radiant as the light of the morning star, and burn it into your retina! (Failnaught's Monologue)

title: A Snowy Yearning
description: The snow glistened as the sun rose overhead. A perfect day to play outdoors after the previous day of heavy snowfall. As we played in the fresh and fluffy snow, I felt I was being watched. A bush nearby looked suspicious to me so I decided to investigate it. As I drew near the bush, I heard a slight sound and a fox cub darted out and into the woods. I didn't think that foxes went "Eeek" when surprised.
listingHtml:
A Snowy Yearning
Global Original

title: A Sparkling Special Time
description: The sparkling lights of the town always set my heart aflutter. That's because beyond every one of them is the smiling face of someone special. "This should be enough shopping for the big holiday party, don't you think?" Even a thief like her will still use her blade to protect the smiles of the ones she cares about. That's what I love so much about the holidays. (From the warm light in Ravina's heart)

description: Our big sis Strie came home from working out of town. I was so happy to see her. "Hehe, I brought presents!" It was a bunny plushie that had ears like the ones on her hat. We all want to buy her a present one day, because she always gets us stuff. (Samine, To Someone Special, Aira Orphanage Creative Writing Assignment)

title: A Tale of the Sun and the Moon
description: The dazzling sun and blue sky cover the world like they're breaking through the dark. Behind that light, the moon silently gazes down. "Sol, it's such a nice day today. Where should we go to next? I'm still hungry." His scarf flutters gently in the wind. Above us there's not a cloud in the sky. In this world, we make our rounds from one delicious restaurant to the next as we conquer the world of food. (Ambitions of the happy moon under the sun)

title: A Taste of Bliss at the Promised Time
description: It was so wonderful, it's hard to believe that I was actually there. Tamamo was in a world of bliss as she enjoyed the dumplings we made, exclaiming, "Mikoto! We finally got to do it! Moon-gazing is the best!" There are those who are frightened of her and some might say she's too selfish, but she's an important friend of mine. She never forgot the promise we made to each other all that time ago, and even went so far as to put this moon-gazing event together for my sake. I cannot help but want to pray for her happiness, and I hope that the Gods will favor her. (Mikoto's Outings Diary)

description: Some things you'll just never forget. Even now, they're some of my most precious memories. "Hehe, come on, it's nothing special really!" title: Fifth Year Anniversary
description: TAC has already reached its 5th anniversary, and along the way I've faced all kinds of challenges that have allowed me to grow as a person. It is because of all the support from our users that this title has become one I feel so strongly about, so thank you all! The story will continue to unfold with more characters and episodes in the future. I'm looking forward to what's to come in the next year for TAC, along with everyone else on the team. Thank you all very much! (RINZO)

description: It was a fierce battle. Some were deformed, some were hard as stone, and some were mere globs of dark mass. Just one came out perfectly. "You did it, Suzuka! Anybody would be happy to be gifted such a heartfelt chocolate!" I almost forgot this was meant to be a gift. I need my comrades that fought through this with me to be by my side when I confirm the results of our efforts. I suppose my quest to be more "ladylike" is nowhere near completion. title: First Mechanical Creation
description: Take it all apart, mod it out, and put it back together again. It never gets old. I feel like a parent raising their kids. Yep. “Every day is a good day when You're working with Mechs.” That’s what I always say. “Aaand done! Ehehe! Perfect!” I still remember my first day working on a Mech. Even after all this time, that memory still brings a smile to my face. The smell of oil, the sound of a motor--I'm still as wrapped up in them as I was that first day. That’s proof of the bond we share, me and that distant family of mine. (Scribbles from Judith's blueprints)

title: Halcyon Days
description: Everyone at the festival is carefree and joyful. Amidst such a peaceful atmosphere, my sister is the brightest spark of joy in my sight. title: Halloween Dedication
description: One day I was presented with a stuffed animal as thanks, much as one would receive flowers. The sudden gift awakened a memory from long ago within me. It was of my very first time trick or treating. "It's no fun if it's not spooky! That's what Halloween's all about!" Neither my lord's wishes nor mine have changed since that day. I don't think they ever will. The smiles of children bring me joy, but there is another whose smile I wish to see even more. (Julia's present thoughts)

title: Halloween Panic
description: N-no! A creature w-without feet! It's so horrible! Elizabeth made a mistake during one of her experiments and made some sort of...living creature?! Still, more than anything, I wish that I hadn't been present when Mei Fang figured out where the creature came from. So...terrifying. I wanna go home. (From the secret diary of Neica)

title: Inherited Iron Will
description: A precious book, a precious time. Moments spent bonding with my dad like this were very special to me. My heart longed not for the hero of the story, but for the smiling man seated next to me. I was innocent then, answering my father's teachings with childish naivete. "What do I want to protect? Hmm... If I have something like that, d'you think I'll be able to grow up to be like you, Dad?" That question was my foundation; the source of the iron will that I inherited from my dad. Together with that faithful old set of armor—dented and scored though it may be—my resolve drove me to keep moving forward, aiming always to follow in his footsteps. (Found scrawled among the pages of Gerald's favorite book)

title: Liu Shen
description: Liu Shen is deputy on board the pirate vessel Xiao Shenmei. He serves as the staunch and capable right-hand man of Captain Shenmei, helping her with her poor sense of direction. He has a penchant for sampling the cuisines of different regions and localities, but has absolutely no culinary skill whatsoever. While he might treat the greatly ambitious Shenmei with a heavy hand, he has firmly resolved to be her shield so that she may realize her dreams.
listingHtml: Liu Shen

title: Live to Ride
description: There is a witch who lives in these lands, one who tears through the sky not on a broom, but astride a motorcycle. It's known as the Ace of Blossoms. One might be inclined to compare it to vehicles from the mechanical country, but there is no comparison to be made. There is none other like it.
listingHtml:
Live to Ride
Slothstein Engineer

title: Living Means Living it Up
description: I didn't expect it to happen, but I reunited with him... the one who puts his heart and soul in his blade. "Really. You eat with such a carefree attitude..." If anything sweet is placed in front of him, his guard comes down completely. Yet he never throws down his trust with the blade. His naivety is only matched by his willpower. The blade's path is determined, but is that really the right way? (Reimei's frustrated thoughts)
listingHtml:
Living Means Living it Up
Wadatsumi Clan

title: On Passion We Soar
description: True fire, faux fire; true justice, and false justice. I believed that charging with reckless abandon was inefficient, but what is truly important is that one does not waver. "We might have different notions about justice, but that will not stop me. I will not hesitate, but simply carry your ideas with me!" I cannot allow the tragedy that befell Wadatsumi to be repeated. Upon this amulet, I swear this oath both unto the Captain, and unto you. For that is the nature of the justice we share. (Seida's Unsent Letter to Monzein)

On one of their adventures, they found a treasure chest packed with apples. "NuMAAA?!" There was enough for one apple each if they shared the spoils. Roxanne is a well-known socialite in Slothstein and just as infamous with the criminal underworld as an information broker. title: Scepter of Sin Luxuria
description: An ancient scepter, said to carry within it the sins of the world from a time when it had fallen into chaos. It was freed from the chains of sin when one who would disrupt the natural order of the world took possession of it. It was then stirred to life again, after lying dormant for many years, by the beings known as the Cursed Beasts.

title: Scheherazade
description: Scheherazade used to be the court painter of the Desert Zone Palace during the times that it was still prosperous. She has a cheerful personality, and she enjoys conversations with just about anyone. On the flipside however, she's more fussy about art than anyone. Though she won't openly negate another person, it is said that she can't deal with people not accepting her ideas.

title: Schmeier
description: One of the seven dragon pillars that uphold the draconic order, Schmeier is known as the dragon of diligence, who tramples through sloth. She is searching far and wide for ways to ensure the survival of the world. She is naturally curious and sometimes seems overly optimistic, but her judgments are always based on thorough assessment of the situation and her remarkable intelligence.

title: Seaside Library
description: She is, without a doubt, incredible. However, I must say that there's really nothing splendid about investigating ruins when you're in a place like this—but I'd never actually tell her that, of course. Her voice interrupts my thoughts, "Yauras, you're not worrying yourself over needless things, are you? You really shouldn't. It isn't like you at all." Even with her sun visor, her eyes are liable to go bad...but I suppose that classifies as a needless worry, too. Come to think of it, it's even less like me to be relaxing by the sea like this, but here I am. At least I know a bit more about how to enjoy myself than she does. (Yauras' Monologue)

title: Second Coming of Absolute Justice
description: I threw away everything to fulfill that promise, but I have no regrets. After all, what's done is done. That's what I wanted to believe anyway. "You continue to ponder the fate of this world, I see." The sword upon my hip shone with a faint light. It recognized my distant yearning. Even if it was some sort of hallucination, it gave me the strength to stand again and leave the past behind me. That was it. That was the symbol of absolute justice. (Kudanstein's inner thoughts)

title: Second Princess' Wish
description: The young future queen Melty is delighted by all these new experiences: a friend of the same age, camping outside, and even water fights! Yet it will disappear one day, like the refreshing and unrelenting barrage of bubbles. "Haha, Melty! You're totally soaked, just like me!" Melty's heart is full with the joy of fun. She hopes that even as time passes, she can hold onto the echoes of it. Maybe if she had some memento of it in the form of something like the beautiful hair ornament Filo wears... She silently makes her wish.

title: Twisted Time Sunk in Frigid Wastes
description: What in the world am I? That is the question I subconsciously ask of the jeweled orb in my hand. What I perceive in response, in the midst of all finite time, is a world of ice, somewhere between dream and reality. An indolent curse falls from my lips: "Humans are troublesome. May they all drown in the depths of their lust, just as this cold world has." Yet I am a student of Ambrosia, the Abstinent Witch, so I must not—will not—wish for such things. Still, as I sat there, I could not help but feel that such thoughts were a part of me, of who I am. (Nyx's thoughts, mid-trance)

description: How long will we continue to fight? When will we be rewarded? After countless battles, we shine as dully as these rings. "Come. Together we will go...beyond the Void." title: Until the Last of the Embers Burns
description: To create weapons from such basic materials with only imagination as her tool... This is a power that can only come from one overflowing with strength. "Heheh... This is gonna be a good one!" A single, ringing sound from the bells in her hair, and then she's happily working on a new weapon. She knows I'm watching, but doesn't let it distract her. As I watch, I feel as if I approach a kind of divinity... This is why I will never stop her. Stopping her from doing such sacred work would be the same as condemning her soul to death. (From the diary of Mei Fang)

description: We were so excited to find a stone as shiny and reflective as a mirror. There was only one of its kind, so it became our shared treasure. "We can all be reflected together if we look into it this way. Let's always look into it together!" Agatha smiled as she peered in from between us. title: What Could Have Been
description: I could see it in my mind: the grand old chapel down two streets from her manor. We often passed by it on the path to Teach's place. I remember the way she'd try to get a peek inside, a hopeful smile on her face. This...woman standing in front of me had Roxanne's face, but nothing else. And yet, when I reached out and held her in my arms, she felt so familiar. Roxanne, what I wouldn't give to walk with you down that aisle like you wanted. To have and to hold you, so radiant and beautiful in a white dress. I never did tell you how I felt all these years... (Siegfried's grief)
